title: Custom 404 & Error Pages
description: Delight your users with branded error pages instead of the default white screen. Handle missing routes with style.

slides.title: The Default 404 Page 🤷
slides.content:
# When a Route Doesn't Exist

Next.js shows a generic 404 page. But you can create your own.

Simply add a **`404.js`** file inside the `pages/` directory.

That's it! No special configuration. Next.js automatically uses it for any unmatched route.

slides.title: Custom 404 (pages/404.js)
slides.content: Make it friendly with a link home and some branding.

quizData.question: Where must you place the custom 404 page?
quizData.explanation: Next.js automatically picks up `pages/404.js` as the custom Not Found page.

slides.title: Custom 500 Error Page ⚙️

quizData.question: The `pages/_error.js` page can only handle 404 errors.
quizData.explanation: `_error.js` is a general error boundary for all HTTP errors. It receives a `statusCode` prop, so you can customise messages for 404, 500, etc.

slides.title: Pro Tip 💡
slides.content: For static sites, `pages/404.html` can also be generated as a static fallback when you run `next export`. But `pages/404.js` works in both server and static modes.
